description: Wisdom, power, and the creation of endless possibilities—CLO 2025.0 is officially launched! Join CLO technical experts for a quick overview of the key features in this release~ This version update brings you 9 brand new features: keyframe animation, panel generator, AI model pose generator, virtual model IK joint mapping, virtual model hip shape adjustment, texture-based layout, range dragging, support for GPU rendering on MAC systems, and real-time hair generation. Additionally, 33 existing features have been upgraded to accelerate your design experience!

summary: ```markdown # CLO 2025.0 New Features Highlight Video: A Quick Overview of Key Updates in the Version! ## Introduction Hello everyone! This video will take you through a quick browse of the new features and highlights of the CLO 2025.0 version. ## AI Model Pose Generator First, let's discuss the main function. Now you can use our AI model pose generator to create all kinds of poses, making the process of creating poses faster and easier. You can not only use the prompt system in the software to quickly generate the pose you want, but you can also combine text input to generate poses. Additionally, you can upload reference pictures to generate specific poses. Once the pose is generated, you can save it to your computer and apply it to other project files. ## Version Generator Optimization In the new version, we have optimized the version generator. You can now use it to create a T-shape by simply entering the size. The system will generate the corresponding paper. You also have the option to manually adjust the parameters to achieve your desired effect. With a click, the system will automatically complete the arrangement and sewing of the version. Furthermore, we can also use the AI version generator. By entering a prompt, you can generate a model picture and create the corresponding version according to it. You can also try other prompts to create or upload the design pattern you designed to generate the version. The system will automatically generate the corresponding size version through built-in program calculations, and you can adjust and modify it as needed. With another click, the generated version will also automatically arrange and sew. ## Animation Key Frame Optimization We have also optimized the function of the animation keyframe in the new version. This can help you achieve quick animation editing while providing more editing options for accurate control. During the animation production process, you can edit and control various elements more freely, such as gravity settings, color editing, and more. ## New Animation Editor Features The new animation editor can help you create more exciting and lively animation works. In the new version, the hole is supported in the 3D window to check the hair effect, allowing you to make quick judgments without the need to open the rendering window. You can select the hair style material type and check the hair effect directly on the 3D window on the left side while the rendering window can be displayed simultaneously. ## Print and Export Function Enhancements The print and export function has also been fully upgraded. The software can now choose to export according to real application requirements, only exporting the current material and locking it in the current position for arrangement. These improvements will unlock more application scenarios for CLO-connection production. ## Brightness Function for Virtual Models Next, I will introduce the brightness function of the virtual model. The AI model workshop has increased the generation background options while improving the overall output effect of the image. You can generate a face first or upload a face picture, choose the background, and combine it with the generated picture. Alternatively, you can enter a specific text description to get the picture, or upload a picture to rebuild the background or show the environment of the costume. ## IK Joint Printing Function In addition, the new version has added the virtual model IK joint printing function, which improves the compatibility of external virtual model models with CLO. You only need to easily select the corresponding position in the 3D window or use the automatic printing function. You can apply all the posture materials in CLO. The flip position function is simple and easy to use, allowing you to flip any posture in the 3D window. ## Virtual Model Editor Updates In the new version of the virtual model editor, the shape adjustment of the hips and chest has been enhanced. For the hips, you can control the curve shape on both sides and adjust the degree to which the hips are up or down. For the chest, you can now select and add the scale size and apply different chest shapes through the switch option. ## Updates to the 3D Window Now, let's look at the relevant updates of the 3D window. Our UV editor has been changed from the mode to the editor interface. In the main menu bar's material UV toolbar download menu, you can now show the reverse and side of the texture. ## Quick Photo Functionality When you take a quick photo of the 3D window image, you can choose the color you want to save, whether saving a single or multiple quick photos. You can quickly export multiple color quick photos from the project file for display. In the rendering window, you can now set the depth of each self-defined view. Using the left mouse button to determine the focal point, CLO will automatically apply it to the corresponding self-defined view setting. ## Optimization of Keypad Function Now, I will introduce you to the optimization of the keypad function. In CLO, you can use a false needle to create multiple focal points for a keypad. By clicking on the keypad and the desired location, you can easily add a focal point. This new function allows you to create multiple fixed positions on a keypad, achieving a more realistic keypad simulation. ## Simulation Function Updates Next, we have updates regarding simulation. The new range drag tool can help you control the area range and strength of the effect when you open the simulation, allowing for faster and more accurate clothing adjustments. ## User Interface Improvements Regarding user interface updates, when you open a project file, you can choose to display it according to the status when saving the file. You can also annotate the layout of the new CLO, add previously collected files to the new drawing library, transfer them to the label page, and rename them. ## Material Function Updates Now, you can directly switch colors by clicking on the color block in the object window, and you can use the shortcut key to open the color editor. In the color editor, you can check and adjust the front, back, or side colors of the fabric, making it easier for everyone to use the color editor to edit material colors. ## Label Function Optimization I will now introduce the optimization of the label function. You can open the 2D window to set relevant settings for the label information of the version, such as size, color, and direction of the font, making the label information clearer. ## Final Thoughts Finally, let's take a look at the brightness function update regarding 2D CAD. The optimization of the generated round and smooth curve tool has added a new usage method to adjust the curve shape, allowing for better control and editing of the curve. You can now adjust the selected curve separately without affecting other parts, achieving more free and accurate curve adjustments. In addition, there are more new functions coming in this version. Welcome to the latest version of CLO! Please keep following us. ```
